description: GEER - 2026 M7.8 Offshore Sarangani, Mindanao, Philippines Earthquake is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Kristin Ulmer, Southwest Research Institute (swri.org). This project documents geotechnical impacts of the June 8, 2026, M7.8 Mindanao, Philippines earthquake. The earthquake caused over 100 fatalities, widespread injuries, and significant disruption to critical infrastructure, including hospitals, schools, power grids, and transportation networks. The earthquake also led to many geotechnical impacts from landslides, tsunami, liquefaction, and coastal uplift. Coverage: Mindanao, Philippines. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: reconnaissance, earthquake engineering, liquefaction, landslides,  tsunami, Philippines. Published 2026-09-17. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
